Editorial Policy

Our articles are based on attributed source material. We prioritize official announcements, documentation and credible reporting. AI may assist drafting and translation. We require useful source-supported context, practical implications, clear distinctions between confirmed facts and uncertainty, and transparent attribution. We prohibit fabricated quotes, unsupported claims, misleading headlines, and unattributed copying. When a claim cannot be confirmed, we label uncertainty or do not publish it. Readers can request corrections.
